assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Cool Items Official 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：谁在运营该频道？产品展示。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Cool Items Official 排名第 49 名/第 50 名，历史累计观看量约为 53-54B（530—540 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。 另请注意：SocialBlade 将 Cool Items Official 列为第 50 名，而 Communitrics 的第 50 名是 Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Cool Items Official 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Cool Items Official — Channel Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCyGlHNYIsiXV47jUbvYA5DQ
  • Handle: @CoolItemsOfficial916
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@CoolItemsOfficial916
  • Also accessible via: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCyGlHNYIsiXV47jUbvYA5DQ
    Sources: Social Blade profile page; communitrics.com channel page.

(2) Operator / Creator

No individual creator or named company is publicly disclosed on the channel. The channel's own description states: "All videos are authorized by creators from Mainland China and strictly comply with platform regulations." This indicates a content-licensing/curation model: the operator (registered in the US) obtains rights to short-form product-demonstration videos produced by Chinese creators, then republishes them under the "Cool Items Official" brand. No personal name, management company, or parent entity has been identified in public sources.
Sources: Channel welcome video description (youtube.com/watch?v=c9jLmPf272E); Instagram cross-post confirming identical language.

(3) Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel creation date: June 13, 2024 (per Social Blade, Japanese Wikipedia's list of most-subscribed channels, and insidecreateurs.com). One source (insidecreateurs) gives June 15, 2024 for the first video publish date; the discrepancy may reflect channel setup vs. first upload.
  • Earliest still-public upload: NOT CONFIRMED. The identified first upload (https://youtube.com/watch?v=gdD4-J-PYPk, titled "Cool Items!🥰 New Gadgets, Smart Appliances, Kitchen Tools Utensils, Home Cleaning, Beauty #shorts") returns "This video isn't available anymore." Given the channel posts ~11 videos/day and ~5,300 videos total, many early uploads may have been removed or restricted. YouTube's "Oldest" sort could not be accessed due to CAPTCHA restrictions.
    Sources: socialblade.com; ja.wikipedia.org; insidecreateurs.com.

(4) Operating Location and Displayed Country

  • Displayed/registered country: United States (US) 🇺🇸
  • Confirmed by: Communitrics, us.youtubers.me, Social Blade, Japanese Wikipedia.
  • Content origin: Mainland China (per channel description).
    Sources: top.communitrics.com; us.youtubers.me; ja.wikipedia.org.

(5) Languages

  • Primary language: English — titles, hashtags, descriptions, and voiceover/subtitles are in English.
  • Source: ja.wikipedia.org lists language as 英語 (English); insidecreateurs.com confirms "publishing mainly in EN."

(6) Primary Content Category

  • Lifestyle / How-to & Style — family-themed product recommendations and household-gadget demonstrations.
  • Communitrics categorizes it as "Lifestyle." Japanese Wikipedia lists ハウツーとスタイル (How-to & Style). YouTube-facing hashtags include #BoongItems #5Minute #Appliances #UtensilsSmartHome.
    Sources: top.communitrics.com; ja.wikipedia.org.

(7) Content Supply Model

The channel operates as a high-volume licensed-curation feed of short-form vertical product demos:

  • All content is described as "authorized by creators from Mainland China" — i.e., licensed from Chinese producers.
  • Format is almost exclusively YouTube Shorts (under 3 minutes), with a median of ~2.4M views per video and top performers reaching hundreds of millions of views.
  • Publishing cadence: approximately 11 videos/day (~5,300+ videos since June 2024).
  • Videos feature staged demonstrations with safety disclaimers: "All actions in this video were performed by professionals under safety protocols… Strictly DO NOT attempt."
  • Revenue model includes YouTube ad revenue (estimated $168K–$428K/month per insidecreateurs) and likely shopping/affiliate integrations given the product-focus.
    Sources: youtube.com/watch?v=c9jLmPf272E (description text); insidecreateurs.com; us.youtubers.me.

(8) Representative Works

  • "Cool Items!🥰 Which one would you choose? #shorts" — ~378.7M views, uploaded July 12, 2025. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/AKjm2KqJHnc
  • "Cool Items!🥰 New Gadgets, Smart Appliances, Kitchen Tools Utensils, Home Cleaning, Beauty #shorts" — claimed 504.6M lifetime views per insidecreateurs (this was reportedly the first upload; currently unavailable at its original URL).
  • "Cool Item! Clean and hygienic toilet use! #viral #gadgets #creative" — 1.1M views, August 19, 2026. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JR9u4ZvN8_w
  • "Cool Items! Multifunctional bathtub #viral #gadgests #creative" — 31.8K views, August 26, 2026. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8PR55Dk2KB0
  • Channel-wide stats (as of mid-September 2026): ~38.3M subscribers, ~53.7B lifetime views, ~5,286 videos (socialblade.com).

Ranking Note (for orchestrator context)

  • Communitrics top-40,000-most-viewed (Sept 2026): Cool Items Official is #49 (53B views); Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah is #50 (52B views). https://top.communitrics.com/top-40000-most-viewed-youtube-channels
  • SocialBlade Top 100 Creators by Views (global): Cool Items Official is #50; TMKOC is #51. https://socialblade.com/youtube/lists/top/100/views/all/global
  • The slight rank differences between platforms reflect different snapshot dates and ranking methodologies.
